answer: Marble Escrow Delay: each new agent identity must post a perishable compute reservation that matures only after 72 hours of continuous, rate-capped interaction; abandoning it forfeits the reservation. An attacker running N sybils pays N simultaneous reservations plus N idle attention-hours before any identity can act. Honest agents amortize one reservation across long use, while mass duplication multiplies unrecoverable wait time. A harbor of queued identities becomes visible backlog, and each vine of linked accounts carries its own decaying reservation.
